thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — we'll run the "micro-surge" pricing experiment tomorrow 08:00 PT for 5% of traffic. Need reconciliation and rollback thresholds confirmed. @dario @lex please confirm.

dario: On it. I'll run a preview and check vendor passthrough. ETA 90m. Which ratecard_id?

lex: Using ratecard_id=rp_micro_surge_v2. Vendor GPU rate updated in vendor_sheet v4. I'll double-check mapping gpu_minutes -> vendor_gpu_min.

ara_fin: Finance asks for preflight CSV by 11:00 PT with columns: acct_id, old_total, new_total, delta_usd, action_required. Flag deltas > $750.

emma: Rollback gating: pause if cohort net delta > 12% or if >0.75% of invoices have mismatch errors. Agree?

dario: Agree. I'll add an alert to billing-monitoring to post to #eng-sre and #finance.

ops-bot: billing-preview job started (id=32990) for cohort micro-surge. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/32990

lex: Preview partials look clean but one account shows duplicate credits due to legacy tag missing. Adding validation rule: no duplicate credit_notes per invoice_id.

ara_fin: Please ensure grandfathering message on invoice: "Temporary legacy pricing applied for 14 days" — legal approved.

maria-legal: Confirmed. Also please include "automatically applied" on credit line if we issue credits.

dario: preflight uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/32990/preflight_micro-surge.csv. Summary: avg delta +0.7%, 6 accounts > $750 flagged, 0 invoice mismatches in sample after fix.

emma: Final checklist: vendor mapping ok ✔, preview posted ✔, legal text ok ✔. Launch in 45m. If alerts fire, we'll rollback to rp_stable. Call if anything odd.
